definitions.gloss: one book; one volume; one copy of a bound publication
definitions.explanation: The counter 冊 is used for books, magazines, notebooks, and other bound volumes. 一冊 counts one such item.

examples.japanese: {本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一冊|いっさつ}⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一冊|いっさつ}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{残|のこ}っていた→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Only one copy remained on this shelf.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一冊|いっさつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}みたい→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I want to read as many books as possible during summer vacation.

notes:
The counter ⟦{冊|さつ}→〜冊：00666_satsu⟧ is one of the most commonly used Japanese counters. It counts bound printed materials: books, magazines, notebooks, manga volumes, etc.

COUNTING PATTERNS:
- {一冊|いっさつ} (1) — note the っ sound change
- {二冊|にさつ} (2)
- {三冊|さんさつ} (3)
- {四冊|よんさつ} (4)
- {五冊|ごさつ} (5)
- {六冊|ろくさつ} (6)
- {七冊|ななさつ} (7)
- {八冊|はっさつ} (8) — note the っ sound change
- {九冊|きゅうさつ} (9)
- {十冊|じゅっさつ} (10) — note the っ sound change
- ⟦{何冊|なんさつ}→何冊：08778_nansatsu⟧: how many books?

USAGE:
Applies to any bound publication including {本|ほん} (books), ⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧ (magazines), ⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧ (manga), ⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧ (dictionaries), ⟦ノート→ノート：00738_nooto⟧ (notebooks), ⟦{手帳|てちょう}→手帳：04537_techou⟧ (planners).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧: one copy — used for documents, reports, and forms rather than bound books
- {一巻|いっかん}: one volume/scroll — used for scrolls, serial publications, and multi-volume sets
